column1: # Reviewer verdicts on keyboard wordlists - an OVERLAY on dictionary/main_<lang>.combined,
# applied by tools/apply_verdicts.py after any wordlist build. The source lists are not edited
# by hand; this file is the record of every change, with who decided it and on what source.
# form     the form as stored in the wordlist (Cyrillic lists: the internal Latin, e.g. uk `krasotu`)
#          keep   - reviewed, stays as it is (so the cross filter stops showing it)
#          demote - stays, frequency set to `target` (a number 0-255)
#          fix    - replaced by `target` (a form of the same list), frequency kept
# target   for demote: the new frequency; for fix: the corrected form; else empty
# source   URL of the normative dictionary the verdict rests on
